patterns: APPSC asks: correct chronology of Later Mughals, Koh-i-Noor plunderer (Nadir Shah), first/last Nizam, Nizam who took Subsidiary Alliance (Nizam Ali Khan, 1798).
Match-the-person items (Husain Ali - Sayyid, Murshid Quli - Bengal, Chin Qilich Khan - Hyderabad, Safdar Jung - Awadh) are a recurring APPSC shape.
Strong Hyderabad/Asaf Jahi tilt for AP: founder Mir Qamar-ud-din, Operation Polo 1948, last Nizam Osman Ali Khan.
Other PSCs add epithets (Rangeela, Zinda Pir) and Third Panipat basics; historiography of decline rarely appears in PYQs.
App includes many ancient-invader items (Darius, Hunas) that drift from the topic but are factually sound.
